{{Infobox film awards|number=70|award=WGA Awards|date=February 11, 2018|organizer=[[Writers Guild of America, East]] and the [[Writers Guild of America, West]]|last=[[69th Writers Guild of America Awards|69th]]|next=[[71st Writers Guild of America Awards|71st]]}}

The '''70th [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''' honored the best in film, television, radio and video-game writing of 2017. Winners were announced on February 11, 2018, at the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]], [[Beverly Hills]], California and the Edison Ballroom, New York City, New York.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://awards.wga.org/wga-awards/awards-show-details|title=2017-2018 Awards Timeline|access-date=December 7, 2017|work=[[Writers Guild of America]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.wgaeast.org/news-events-awards/writers-guild-awards/the-70th-writers-guild-awards/|title=The 70th Writers Guild Awards|work=Writers Guild of America East|access-date=2018-02-16|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180216204539/https://www.wgaeast.org/news-events-awards/writers-guild-awards/the-70th-writers-guild-awards/|archive-date=2018-02-16|url-status=dead}}</ref> The nominations for Television, New Media, Radio, News and Promotional Writing were announced on December 7, 2017,<ref>{{cite web|last1=Littleton|first1=Cynthia|title=Writers Guild Award TV Nominations: 'The Americans,' 'Handmaid's Tale,' 'GLOW' Grab Multiple Mentions|url=https://variety.com/2017/tv/news/writers-guild-award-tv-nominations-americans-handmaids-tale-glow-1202632895/|website=Variety|date=December 7, 2017|access-date=December 7, 2017}}</ref> the Theatrical and Documentary Screenplay nominees were announced on January 4, 2018,<ref>{{cite web|last1=Lewis|first1=Hilary|title=WGA Awards: 'Get Out,' 'Logan,' 'The Big Sick' Among Film Nominations|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/2018-wga-awards-movies-doc-nominations-revealed-1071581|website=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 4, 2018|access-date=January 4, 2018}}</ref> and the Videogame Writing nominees were announced on January 11, 2018.<ref>{{cite web|title=2018 Writers Guild Awards: Videogame Writing Nominations Announced|url=http://www.wga.org/news-events/news/press/2018/2018-videogame-writing-nominations-announced|publisher=WGA|date=January 11, 2018|access-date=January 11, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Nyren |first=Erin |date=11 February 2018 |title=WGA Awards: Updated Winners List |url=https://variety.com/2018/film/awards/2018-wga-award-winners-complete-list-1202694807/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180218002442/https://variety.com/2018/film/awards/2018-wga-award-winners-complete-list-1202694807/ |archive-date=18 February 2018 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref>

The West Coast show was hosted by [[Patton Oswalt]] and the East Coast show was hosted by [[Amber Ruffin]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.wga.org/news-events/news/press/2017/patton-oswalt-returns-to-host-2018-writers-guild-awards-ceremony|title=Patton Oswalt Returns to Host 2018 Writers Guild Awards L.A. Ceremony |date=December 5, 2017 |publisher=WGA |access-date=December 7, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.wgaeast.org/2017/12/amber-ruffin-to-host-70th-annual-writers-guild-awards-ceremony-in-new-york/|title=Amber Ruffin to Host 70th Annual Writers Guild Awards Ceremony in New York|date=2017-12-04|work=Writers Guild of America East|access-date=2018-02-16|language=en-US}}</ref>
